sources.quote: A dilatant (/daɪˈleɪtənt/, /dɪ-/) (also termed shear thickening[1]) material is one in which viscosity increases with the rate of shear strain.

Oobleck is a dilatant fluid..why: Oobleck is the standard example of a dilatant fluid (Wikipedia's article and teaching pages); it is called a non-Newtonian fluid far more often than a dilatant one, so the class link is weaker than oobleck's own behaviour, which is stated by name very often (w1).
